fieldValues.title: RFC-038 grandfather repointed off dead #297; allowlist entries now require a disposition
fieldValues.summary: rfcs/integration-allowlist.json's grandfathered["038"] cited #297, closed 2026-08-14 with RFC-038's fold still undeclared. Repointed at new issue #633 (which now owns the actual manifest-declaration work), and check-rfc-integration.mjs now requires every allowlist entry to carry a disposition ("permanent" | "pending"), mirroring #590's identical fix to the sibling publication-reachability-exclusions.json.
